FIELDS.NAME: Silk Petals Floral Supplies
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Silk Petals Floral Supplies specializes in the retail and wholesale of artificial flowers and floral supplies. Our operations are focused on providing high-quality products for floral arrangements, catering to both individual customers and event planners. Our inventory includes a wide range of silk flowers, decorative stems, floral accessories, and arrangement tools. We conduct sales primarily through our brick-and-mortar store, ensuring personalized customer service and in-depth consultation for custom designs. Our storage areas are secured and climate-controlled to protect the integrity of our products, and all employees undergo rigorous safety and operational training to uphold workplace safety standards. We are committed to complying with local zoning laws, fire codes, and business licensing regulations, ensuring that we operate within a legally sound framework. Delivery services, while offered, make up less than 20% of our overall revenue, allowing us to manage and mitigate transportation-related risks effectively.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 01/15/2023; Cause: Water damage from a burst pipe in the storage area; Amount: $1,500; Status: Resolved with repairs and inventory replacement. Loss dates: 03/25/2023; Cause: Minor theft of floral supplies; Amount: $1,000; Status: Reported to authorities and insurance claim submitted.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around the storage area and regular presence of a licensed security patrol during non-business hours.
